title: Nucleotide salvage during hypoxia
summary: Nucleotide salvage is an energy-efficient pathway that maintains ATP pools under hypoxia and hypothermia.

title: Purine recycling in torpor-like states
summary: Purine salvage increases phosphorylated nucleotide products while precursor bases decrease during torpor-like cooling.

title: Pyrimidine salvage in metabolic stress
summary: Pyrimidine salvage products CMP and UMP rise when de novo synthesis substrates are limited.

title: Pathway enrichment background
summary: Untargeted metabolomics often highlights nucleotide metabolism under energetic stress.

title: Precursor-product inversion pattern
summary: A precursor-to-product inversion pattern is a hallmark of activated salvage rather than de novo synthesis.
